title: Tropical Cyclone Climatology
measures: The Atlantic hurricane season runs from June 1 to November 30; the climatological peak is September 10, with most activity between mid-August and mid-October; activity sometimes occurs outside those dates.
limitations: Basin-wide climatology; says nothing about a particular city's risk in a given year.

title: Florida Statutes § 466.019 – Advertising by dentists (2026 Florida Statutes)
measures: Defines 'advertisement' to include websites and social media; prohibits false, fraudulent, misleading or deceptive statements, including laudatory statements about the dentist, statements comparing the quality of dental services with other services, claims likely to create unjustified expectations of favourable results, appeals primarily to fears, and fee information without a disclaimer that it is a minimum fee only; requires a specified in-person-examination disclaimer when certain telehealth services are advertised. History cites s. 3, ch. 2024-214.
limitations: Statute text only; interpretation belongs to the Board of Dentistry and the practice's counsel.

title: Florida Statutes § 456.062 – Advertisement of free or discounted services; required statement
measures: Any advertisement for a free, discounted-fee or reduced-fee service, examination or treatment by a practitioner licensed under chapter 466 must include the statutory statement (right to refuse, cancel or be reimbursed for payment for other services performed within 72 hours of responding) in capital letters clearly distinguishable from the rest of the text; limited classified-directory exception.
limitations: Statute text only; not legal advice.

title: Rule 64B5-4.002, F.A.C. – Advertising and Soliciting by Dentists
publisher: Florida Department of State, Florida Administrative Rules (FLRules)
measures: Applies to media exposure of any nature, paid or not. All advertising must identify the Florida-licensed dentist who takes responsibility (license number, or commonly used name with the current full name, address and phone on file with the Department). In-person and telephone solicitation is prohibited (scheduling and follow-up with patients or former patients excepted). Advertising may not name people who neither practise at the advertised location nor own the practice; a previous owner may be named for up to 2 years with written permission. Referral-service disclosures. 'Sleep dentistry' only with a general anesthesia permit. Amended 4-26-26 and 9-24-26; the 2026 notices describe requiring disclosure of the licensee's full name.
limitations: Rule text as published on FLRules (Word file of the adopted rule); the practice's counsel should confirm how it applies.

title: How to set Special hours
measures: Special hours cover temporary hour changes or closures of up to 6 days in a row; for 7 or more days in a row, or an unknown period, Google says to mark the business Temporarily closed; special hours show only when the profile is set to 'Open with main hours'; bulk spreadsheet option for multiple locations.
limitations: Help article; undated; Google may change it.

title: Dental Care in Medicaid Programs: data tables (December 2025)
measures: Florida: adult Medicaid dental benefit classified 'Emergency-only' for 2021–2025 (HPI data as of August 2025); 25.6% of Florida dentists enrolled as Medicaid/CHIP providers in 2024 (32.8% in 2023); 40.7% of Florida children aged 1–20 continuously enrolled in Medicaid/CHIP visited a dentist in 2024; 63.6% of privately insured Florida children did in 2023.
limitations: State-level only; never a city figure. Participation is defined by Insure Kids Now enrolment or FQHC practice, per HPI notes.
